scope: Read-only source/setup audit; no numerical kernel or study configuration changed. Does not validate flutter or resolve the discrepancy.

25.alternate_reference_axis_definition: Literal elastic axis from Table 3.7: Cea=0, Nea=0.001 m. Subtract M*((mean Ccg-Cea)^2+(mean Ncg-Nea)^2). The prior alternative subtracted the chordline normal offset mean Ncg instead.

75.alternate_reference_axis_definition: Literal elastic axis from Table 3.7: Cea=0, Nea=0.001 m. Subtract M*((mean Ccg-Cea)^2+(mean Ncg-Nea)^2). The prior alternative subtracted the chordline normal offset mean Ncg instead.

findings.finding: Distributed mgcc/mgnn are strongly supported as section-centroid inertias: the whole-CG results differ from Table 2.21 by -0.01536% / +0.02906%. The literal EA alternative at Nea=0.001 m gives 4.266141603750322e-5 / 6.216922514734592e-5 kg m^2 (-18.7556% / -3.0273%). This supports the convention, but does not prove the exact original ASWING input.

Weighted Ncg agrees with Table2.9 normal CG relative to chordline, despite section3.9 prose saying both CG coordinates are referenced to EA. Tables support retaining Ncg literally rather than adding Nea.

Representation 2 uses alpha_A=-alpha_L0, supporting section alpha=+4 degrees for zero-lift incidence=-4 degrees. For the reconstruction frame span +z, chord +x, normal -y, positive geometric incidence maps to body beta. The thesis confirms physical turntable incidence but does not document the original computational body beta or provide its .pnt input; that software-coordinate mapping remains unverified.

findings.finding: Destruction-test wings were uninstrumented and accelerometers were removed for active wind-tunnel tests. Main study exclusion of tip accelerometers is supported for experiment; appendix instrumented model does not identify the computational Table4.5 setup.

Claim of greater75%static unbalance conflicts with chordwise CG-minus-EA from Tables2.20/2.21:25%=10.64mm,75%=4.39mm. This does not justify modifying data;75%EA is farther aft of aerodynamic centre, a distinct effect.

Section 4.2 and Figure 4.10 explicitly cover cases 1-4 at physical incidence 4.17 degrees; Case 4 is solid. The 25% plotted torsion branch starts near 35.1 Hz, crosses near 21 Hz and stays unstable over the shown path; the 75% crossing is near 19.5 Hz. This supports the qualitative Case 4 comparison with the reconstructed unstable pocket. These approximate visual frequencies are not digitized values or validation tolerances; the precisely tabulated Case 4 speeds are 33.21 and 24.58 m/s. Original body beta remains undocumented.

findings.finding: Exact integration of Table 3.6 gives 75% mass 0.07249940642529322 kg, versus Table 2.21 0.0726 kg (-0.1385586%). Retain this discrepancy; do not scale mass to remove it. The corresponding 25% discrepancy is -0.0039121%.

next_discriminating_check.priority: Use current saved finite-speed points to compare low-speed mode drift and root-locus shape with source, then independently verify finite-frequency section/strip aerodynamic force and moment transfer at k≈0.19-0.34. Keep both bending and torsion input channels; include lag, circulation-rate lift and apparent mass and their pitch-axis transfer.
next_discriminating_check.why: Whole-wing mass/inertia and zero-speed root fingerprints support reconstruction; discrepancy emerges with finite-speed aerodynamic stiffness/damping. A no-stall, Cm=alpha=0 analogue can isolate loaded-equilibrium/stall feedback, but must be labelled an explicit interpretation of the source flat-plate case because the printed CLmin=+5 entry is inconsistent.
next_discriminating_check.not_supported: Do not fit density, stiffness, CG or aerodynamic coefficients; do not replace main tables with appendix solely to match boundaries; do not treat ARPACK-truncated root loci as proof of complete stability.

revision.description: Correct the alternate inertia axis to literal Nea=0.001 m; retain the prior chordline-axis hypothesis explicitly and qualify source/setup certainty.

unsteady_audit_scope.interpretation: The 48 direct production checks cover apparent force/moment and frame transport only. Lag and circulatory/rate expressions were inspected algebraically. No full-section production transfer, flutter or finite-angle validation follows from those 48 checks.
unsteady_audit_scope.caveat: Steady equations 155-157 use wind-aligned virtual vortex/control points; unsteady equations 29-31 use true quarter-chord motion. The difference vanishes at zero-incidence linearization but survives a finite-incidence tangent. This is an unresolved interpretation, not a demonstrated correction.
